notes: Motif recognition is not where the skill differs: a blind judge (screenshots only, 14 candidate motifs) named the posted motif top-1 for 9/9 runs in both configurations. Theme strength (blind, 1-5): with_skill 4,4,5,5,5,5 (mean 4.67) vs baseline 3,4,5 (mean 4.0); paired: sumi-e 4 vs 3, luxury 5 vs 4, navy 4 vs 5.

House style is fixed: an art-director judge rated the iteration-1 with-skill menus 5/5 'same template recoloured' (tilted yellow pill CTA, mascot, candy emoji tile dock) and the iteration-2 with-skill menus 2/5 (CTA objects, materials, palettes and type differ per motif: exit sign, vermilion seal, flag banner, elevator dial, amber, DQ window).

Remaining shared vocabulary in iteration 2: the layout skeleton (centred CTA + 4-slot bottom dock, partly inherited from the fixture), a radial glow halo behind the CTA in 4/6 runs, and small ALL-CAPS English lore tags.

Discriminating assertions: CJK bold weight (baseline 2/3 fail), Roblox top-bar overlap (baseline 2/3 fail, confirmed in Studio: titles hidden under the menu buttons), informed-judge craft (with 5/6 >= 4, baseline 0/3). Non-discriminating (pass in both): contract test, compile, fonts exist, no tofu emoji, reduced motion, preview produced, motif colours present.

Constraint misses with the skill: famicom-rpg (Japanese labels cannot be pixel text with Roblox built-in fonts; the idle ▶ cursor is not shown on START) and navy-harbor (sailor-uniform element only faint on the main menu). Baseline miss: luxury (teal cast instead of black marble, avatar bleeding through a translucent backdrop).

navy-harbor/with_skill hung for 31 min in a large rewrite and was stopped; its outputs are the state at 18:03 (all tests passing, no DESIGN.md). Its time/tokens are not comparable. Excluding it, with_skill averaged 1908 s / 799k tokens vs baseline 1427 s / 684k tokens (+34% time, +17% tokens).
Studio note: sumi-e/with_skill's open animation briefly floods the whole screen vermilion (the seal 'stamps in' from a huge size) around 6 s after Play; settled state is correct.
